{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of flipper_length_mm by species, excluding rows with missing flipper_length_mm
# Since only 2 rows are missing, we can drop them safely
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort to find the species with the highest mean
mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
